profile.headline: Software Engineer at Pluralsight
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with years of experience building and maintaining GraphQL APIs on a Node.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL stack. I currently own core platform APIs at Pluralsight serving 70% of customer ARR, including a green field Analytics API and company wide identity initiatives.

I care most about the parts of engineering that don't show up in a demo: API versioning that doesn't break customers, deprecation programs that actually get adopted, and infrastructure other engineers can build on without asking me first.

positions.title: Software Engineer | Tech Lead
positions.description:
• Served as Tech Lead for a suite of customer facing GraphQL APIs used by 70% of Pluralsight's customer ARR, planned roadmap initiatives with Product, and coordinated delivery across teams

• Designed and built a green field, Snowflake backed GraphQL Analytics API (AWS API Gateway, SQS, Apollo Server, Redis caching) from scratch, including a shadow traffic load testing plugin to validate production readiness before cutover

• Contributed extensively to a platform wide identity migration (userHandle to psUserId) across the GraphQL API surface, converting endpoints incrementally with zero customer facing downtime

• Owned a recurring API deprecation program end to end: built automated deprecation cycle tooling, customer notification emails, and usage reporting to safely retire legacy fields without breaking integrators

• Added SSO deep link support to the customer facing API, part of a broader initiative benefiting a customer base representing $90M in ARR

• Owned dependency and vulnerability remediation across 10+ repositories using Snyk, and built an internal Claude Code plugin to automate that triage process

• Architected a full API key lifecycle system from schema through developer portal UI

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Supported and maintained Pluralsight's public facing GraphQL API (Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL), including schema development, resolver work, and query performance improvements

• Part of the team that built a new integration to consume xAPI data with various partnerships, architected and built from the ground up (Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL)

• Migrated the service to AWS EKS and moved Helm chart deploys to an OCI based container registry

• Contributed to an early wave of the API deprecation program, removing legacy queries and completing a data migration across dozens of channel, team, path, and role queries

• Participated in a company wide LastPass to 1Password credential migration

• Wrote developer portal API documentation, including an API key best practices guide

• Remediated dependency and code level vulnerabilities flagged by Snyk across the team repositories, including ReDoS and SSRF findings

• Strong emphasis on Test Driven Development and pair programming

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• As a software engineer, my primary responsibility was supporting legacy software. I was the lead  developer for the main legacy application. My duties included developing bug fixes, facilitating iterative deploys to multiple servers, and helping problem solve with other squads who have connections to the applications I supported.

• I was also involved in various learning groups, with topics ranging from personal/profession growth, to clean coding, to learning new languages and technologies.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer | Focus on React & Node.js
positions.description:
Unlocked Budget App - a monthly budgeting app to unlock your financial potential.
⧱ URL ➠ https://unlocked.anthonygnl.com
⧳ CODE ➠ https://github.com/agiannell/unlocked-budget-app

Built with React, NodeJS, Express, postgreSQL, Redux, Sass. The Unlocked app lets the user create their own custom budget with unique line items. They can also add each transaction they make and categorize them according to their unique line items,

positions.title: Full Stack Developer | Emphasis on Spotify API
positions.description:
Desktop DJ - a shared experience listening room for friends & coworkers.

⧱ URL ➠ https://deskjockey.anthonygnl.com
⧳ CODE ➠ https://github.com/WR8-Desktop-Dj/wr8-group-project-desktop-dj

Built using React, NodeJS, Express, postgreSQL. This app utilizes technologies such as; Sockets, OAuth, Spotify API, Amazon S3, and Redux. Users can join or create listening rooms to listen to a shared Spotify experience. Users can also utilize a chat feature in their respective rooms to connect with fellow listeners.
